embeds.title: 🔴 Laravel Lang Packages Hijacked to Deploy Credential-Stealing Malware
embeds.description:
Security firms StepSecurity, Aikido Security, and Socket reported a supply chain attack targeting Laravel Lang localization packages. Attackers compromised GitHub version tags across four repositories (laravel-lang/lang, laravel-lang/http-statuses, laravel-lang/attributes, and laravel-lang/actions) to distribute malicious code through Composer packages. According to Aikido, 233 versions across three repositories were compromised, while Socket reported roughly 700 historical versions may have been impacted. The malicious code injected a 'src/helpers.php' file that acted as a dropper, downloading a cross-platform credential stealer from flipboxstudio[.]info that harvests cloud credentials, Kubernetes secrets, Git credentials, CI/CD secrets, SSH keys, browser data, cryptocurrency wallets, and other sensitive information. On Windows, the payload also extracted and executed 'DebugElevator,' designed to target Chrome, Brave, and Edge browsers.
**Sources:** BleepingComputer • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** none • **Access:** Compromised GitHub repository tags distributed via Composer package manager
**Incident date:** 2026-05-23 • **Confidence:** claim
